description: This PHP source file defines the ProviderAPI class, which manages CRUD operations for OpenID Providers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, and deleting OpenID Provider entries, along with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ProviderAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller managing CRUD operations for OpenID Providers, including validation, transaction handling, and integration with authentication services.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all OpenID Providers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new OpenID Provider with the provided details, wrapping the operation in a database transaction.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves or updates an OpenIdProvider entity with data from the request parameters.

methods.name: saveProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Saves additional details related to the provider, such as client ID and secret, encrypting sensitive data if enabled.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint parameters.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates a validation rule for the provider name, ensuring it is unique if required.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Provides options for unique validation of the provider name, ignoring entries with status false.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes OpenID Providers identified by their IDs in the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the delete endpoint parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches details of a single OpenID Provider by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single provider by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing OpenID Provider with new data, ensuring data integrity via transaction management.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the update endpoint parameters.
